Hi Alex / Nexa security team,

Thanks — looping in Karthik (infra) and Laura (compliance) to scope feasibility. Quick answers up front so you can plan:

- Fields: we can provide actor_id, actor_email (when available), actor_role, timestamp_utc, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, session_id, src_ip, user_agent, mfa_verified (boolean), changed_fields (diff-ish summary), and a service-level trace_id for reconstruction.
- Retention: default admin-activity retention is 12 months in the nearline store. We offer a 3-year archival add-on for enterprise customers (policy+SLA).
- Formats: supported exports: CloudTrail-style JSON (recommended for audit ingestion), newline-delimited JSON, gzipped Parquet (cost/easy ingest), and CSV (least fidelity). All exports can be delivered gzipped with AES-256 (KMS) and an HMAC manifest.

Two delivery patterns we usually propose:
1) On-demand attested snapshot: a timebox CSV/JSON/Parquet bundle + signed manifest (SHA256) delivered to a customer S3 bucket. Good for one-off attestations.
2) Nearline daily roll and monthly snapshot: continuous index + monthly attested snapshot for rolling windows. Good when auditors need repeatable windows.

Can you confirm whether you need a per-tenant scoping (Nexa account id only) or tenant+project? Also confirm preferred format (CloudTrail JSON preferred by many auditors). We will prepare a short export-options PDF detailing tradeoffs.

--

Thanks Marissa — attaching the export field schema and a few implementation notes. Summary below.

What we log (admin / privileged actions):
- timestamp_utc (RFC3339)
- actor_id (internal guid), actor_email (redacted unless requested by customer), actor_role (admin|ops|engineer|service-account)
- action (verb): e.g., grant_role, remove_role, create_instance, terminate_instance, change_config
- target_type / target_id (resource slug)
- request_id / trace_id / session_id
- src_ip / user_agent
- mfa_verified (true/false)
- outcome (success/failure) and failure_reason (if any)
- retention_bucket (hot|nearline|archive)

Retention & archival: default is 12 months in nearline. For customers with enterprise contracts we can: extend to 3 years (cold archive with retrieval SLA), or provide an on-prem snapshot for longer custody. Note: cost and egress apply to extended retention.

Export mechanics & security:
- Output formats: cloudtrail_style.json (vector-compatible), ndjson, parquet (snappy), csv
- Delivery: to customer S3 (preferred), SFTP, or secure HTTP POST (with signed URL).
- Integrity: SHA256 manifest + detached PGP signature or KMS HMAC.
- Redaction: PII fields (actor_email) are redacted by default; we can provide mapped hashes or a tokenization table under NDA.
- Sampling: we do not sample admin activity by default (full fidelity). If a customer requests a sampled extract, we include the sampling manifest and seed.

Limitations / notes:
- Session reconstruction for cross-service actions requires correlating trace_id; we include trace_id when available but some historical entries (pre-trace rollout) may have nulls.
- Geo normalization: timestamps are UTC; we provide a zone-normalized view on request.

I'll produce a 30-day test snapshot (CloudTrail JSON) under a demo prefix and include a signed manifest. ETA: Tue 2027-11-09 EOD if we get confirmation on tenant scoping and preferred delivery bucket.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
